name: Slimy Menace
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match.

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.
narrative.objectives: Kill the murlocs at Crystal Lake.
narrative.offerRewardText: I can hear their warbling from here, it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.
